column1: # Mean TPM of 20 wild-type MG1655 M9 glucose (2 g/L), 37C, aerobic samples from PRECISE-1K (github.com/SBRG/precise1k, data/precise1k/log_tpm.csv, TPM = 2^log_tpm - 1).
# Projects: control, ica, minspan, oxyR, ssw, ytf, ytf2, ytf3. Reported growth rates 0.58-0.73 /h (doubling 57-72 min).
# b-numbers mapped to model gene IDs via genes.tsv synonyms. Genes absent from PRECISE are filled with the model's own M9 Glucose minus AAs value (source column) and the column renormalized to 1e6.
# Use as the basal (M9 Glucose minus AAs) expression with the ParCa option --basal-rnaseq precise1k_m9_glucose_tpm.tsv; files for that option need "Gene" and "TPM" columns.
